reported_time_is: the published whole minute, in seconds, not the model's float (docs/s3-decision-report.md)
what_this_does_not_establish: Admissibility is not agreement. A refused walk is not evidence the product was right, and an admissible one that does not trip either limb is not evidence that it was: E3 returns FAILED or UNVERIFIED and never 'supported'.
